text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I want... to win! —I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!! I'm gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Curren Bouquetd'or—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she galloped gracefully across the 
finish line, cheers erupted from the 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expansive race—so true to her style, 
drawing fully upon her stamina—was a 
breathtaking spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I... did it...! I won!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I caught her in an embrace as she came 
running over, something she rarely did. 
From the warmth of her trembling joy—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Put the Umamusume first. Always keep them 
as your top priority.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single guiding principle taught to me 
during my days as an assistant trainer, 
one I have never wavered on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I was able to win in my own way...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, right now, I felt as though— I 
had just received a massive answer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...―― Fufu, fufufu!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: No... no! Please take it...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm your sweet pea...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...My heart is still full.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if I managed to get through to 
Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If you can run your own way and win on 
top of that—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was something that could prove he had 
been right all along.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was something that could prove she had 
been right all along.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...— I wonder... if it got through.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(As I ran, they just came pouring out. My 
feelings for you, Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to bring him into the light. 
And tell him thank you. So, so much.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to bring her into the light. 
And tell her thank you. So, so much.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(To do that, after all――I need victory. I 
must add one more, even greater bloom of 
victory.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I discussed future race 
rotations with Karen Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Regarding what's next— how about the 
"Oaks"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I've gathered these sweet peas 
for you, the flower that came to mind was 
indeed... a grand bloom radiant on the 
Tiara path."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Take hold of the shining blossom of the 
oak, which can only be claimed at the 
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Gather them, bind them together, and then— 
I wish to shape them into a golden 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at those eyes burning with hope, 
I am reminded of the 'Sweetpea Stakes.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she will surely conquer the 
Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks). That feeling 
welled up inside me naturally.
choice_data_list: Understood, let's aim for the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sure of it—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is that grand stage, the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). Believing in a 
shining future, we have only to push 
forward!"
